verdict.rationale: Sentry documents natural-language querying of telemetry: Seer Agent claims to answer any question about your application by finding the right telemetry, and the official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance. Nothing shows the answer comes back as a real, inspectable query or a generated chart or widget, and all support is a single-line vendor claim. Missing for 10: evidence that NL questions produce an editable Explore/Discover query or a dashboard chart, in-depth docs on Seer Agent's query behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
